description: A ground-level photograph captured in 2012 depicts a wide, dry river bank composed of various sizes of light grey, white, and brown pebbles and gravel covering the foreground. In the midground, a horizontal band of dense green vegetation, including deciduous trees and shrubs, separates the river bank from the background. Behind the vegetation, a forested hill range extends across the left and central background under a cloudy sky, with two electricity pylons visible on the left side of the forested slope. On the far right, a prominent, steep, reddish-brown cliff face rises sharply, showing signs of erosion, with some sparse vegetation at its base and top. The image illustrates a natural river bank environment with minimal vegetation. Text in the bottom left corner indicates "Photographed in 2012 / LCKJ".
